column1: To use this sheet, you will need to make a copy first to be able to edit (File -> Make a copy). Enter "Yes" if the category is used in your league or "No" if it is not in the "Category Used?" row. Then use the "Weight" row to assign a points weight to each category. You only need to enter information into the cells highlighted in red. The rows highlighted in green will output the total number of projected Fantasy Points and the projected Fantasy Points per game played for your league.
